title: Chapter 150
text:
"I'm a closed beta player from Big Horn Village. A few days ago, I was at Black Phantom's place and changed my class to Mechanic. I thought it was a strong class, but after changing, I realized that the Mechanic class was completely different from what I thought it was. Its skills were rubbish, it failed to repair, and my equipment was damaged. I had to buy materials to repair it again. My pistol was broken like that.

My pistol was so f * cking weak. A public beta player who was four levels lower than me challenged me to a PK. He didn't have a main class, and his secondary class was a [Hunter]. I fought with him 11 times, and I didn't win even once! I lost to a secondary class with a primary class, and I was four levels higher than him. The Mechanic class was sh * t, and I could only be a life profession player.

… I was attracted by Black Phantom's video. I was f * cking fooled. Those high-level NPCs always have bonuses. Black Phantom is not a player, and his combat power is not convincing at all!

… The Mechanic class was unbearably weak in the early stages. Maybe it could be as strong as Black Phantom in the later stages, but it was behind the starting line in the early stages. It would take a long time to reach the level of others! Also, the Mechanic class relied on machines to fight, and the materials to build machines cost money. This class was only for the rich, and it couldn't be played without money!

The Mechanic class has no future. My account is useless, and I can only delete it and start again. Rubbish class! "

Luzman's reply was full of resentment, and he even attached the video of his consecutive PK losses. Many people agreed and pushed him to the top of the list.

Glancing at the other posts, Han Xiao realized that most of the posts had traces of Luzman. That guy had copied and pasted the same post many times, and he was filled with resentment. This kind of behavior made many people feel disgusted, and some people also argued with Luzman.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He was not surprised. Players would find out sooner or later that the Mechanic class was not suitable for combat in the early stages. Luzman was the first, but he would not be the last. These people who complained were attracted by him. They chose whichever class they thought was strong, and when they found out that it was completely different from the class they imagined, they felt cheated and were angry.

There were also players who liked the Mechanic class and ignored these arguments. Some people played games for fun, and some people played games to be the best. Luzman obviously belonged to the latter.

These negative comments would more or less affect his business. There was only one chance to choose a main class, so the players would become more cautious, especially the first batch of players.

Han Xiao shook his head. He still wanted to attract more players into the Mechanic class and expand his market.

"It seems like I need to strengthen the players' confidence in the Mechanic class. However, just displaying my strength is not enough …"

The program was still going on. The male host changed the topic and said, "We have obtained the first cut of the next unreleased promotional video from Xing Hai. Please take a look."

Another video played on the screen. Just like the official announcement of Galaxy, this promotional video focused on the battle scenes of various professions.

The Heavy Armored Knight's entire body was bursting with flames, and the tip of his spear burst forth with a qi aura. He collided with a group of Iron Shield Guards, and the sound of the collision was like a clap of thunder. Shadows of people fluttered in the air.

A race with horns on their heads controlled the elements. Flames coiled around their bodies like a long snake.

The hooded Magician started chanting, and a complicated Light Magic Circle appeared under his feet. Dazzling magic light spurted out from his fingers.

The bald, ascetic-like Psychic controlled objects and released invisible mental attacks. The enemies surrounding him fell like wheat being cut down. Blood spurted out of their nostrils.

The scene was very realistic. All kinds of lights and shadows were dazzling, making people's blood boil!

This was the first cut of the promotional video, and it had not been finalized yet. The scenes were recorded by players from various novice planets. For the time being, only a few high-level characters showed their combat strength. It barely gathered the battle scenes of the five main classes. Among them, the Mechanic class was the scene of Black Phantom. Han Xiao was the first high-level character to show his combat strength.

There was a glimpse of Big Horn Mountain, part of the battle of Tedramira River, sniper rifles, turrets, rangers, and even Mad Blade's Angry Sword were shown.

The players who were watching finally came back to their senses. The bullet screen was full of comments to express their excitement and shock.

"I didn't expect to be chosen for the promotional video."

Han Xiao was a little surprised. He still remembered the promotional video of this version in his previous life. The scene of the Mechanic class was a process of manufacturing machinery. This made the players think that it was a logistics class. Of course, very few people changed to the Mechanic class.

According to the statistics of Version 1.0, the proportion of Mechanic class players was only 9.7%! His version of the promotional video would definitely attract a large number of players. The Mechanic class would definitely not be as bad as before. It would attract more players. Even if there were regretful Mechanic class players complaining on the forum, it would not have a big impact.

The promotional video also increased his popularity, which was more effective than the players' praise. Han Xiao was very happy. He estimated that his popularity would rise again.

The next segment of the program was the trend of the professional players. The male host said, "In the ten days of the open beta, many famous e-sports clubs have switched to Galaxy. According to the statistics, the Esper class is currently the most popular class. This class is like a lottery. If you get an ability with high potential, it's like winning a lottery ticket of ten million dollars. Your future is limitless.

It is known that America, South Korea, France, Japan, and Switzerland have all shown strong Espers with Grade A potential. The big clubs have made offers for these accounts, which are worth millions of dollars. "

The bullet screen was in an uproar. Buying a novice account with millions of dollars was like winning the lottery! If you were lucky, you could become rich straight away.

"Latest news: America's Devil Club, Sandstorm Club, France's Tulip Club, and South Korea's Four Stars Club have all bought accounts and will be controlled by the top players of the clubs.

The god-level players will still use their own accounts. The god-level players of America's Devil Club, 'King and Queen' (K&Q), have changed to the Mage class and obtained a rare talent through a hidden mission. The god-level players of France's Tulip Club, 'Lost Angel', have chosen to start randomly and seem to have obtained a special opportunity. South Korea … "

The foreign e-sports players all had good performances. The Chinese e-sports players were not weak, but they rarely reached the top. The champion's thrones of various competitions had been dominated by the clubs of America, France, Japan, and South Korea for a long time. If they could win the championship once, it would be like celebrating a festival.

"The domestic players also had good performances. A player with the ID 'Maple Moon' completed the prize-pool mission alone and obtained more than 100,000 EXP. She became the biggest winner, which is very beneficial for her future development. Maybe she can accumulate advantages like a snowball. This mission is related to Black Phantom …

A dark horse with the ID 'Mad Blade Raging Sword' has appeared among the professional players. Yesterday, Rivertown Club, which Mad Blade Raging Sword is in, held a press conference and released a video of the battle between Black Phantom and Mad Blade Raging Sword. Everyone should have noticed that Mad Blade Raging Sword has appeared on screen. He seems to have triggered Black Phantom's hidden storyline … "

The video of Mad Blade Raging Sword was sent to him by Sleepy Winter. In order to increase their reputation, the club used it for publicity. When the Chinese professional players were in a slump, this move made Mad Blade Raging Sword receive a lot of attention.

"… That's the content of this episode. Look forward to seeing you next time. Next is the lucky draw. How many times has Black Phantom been mentioned in this episode? Please send your answer to the official account, and we will draw ten people … "

Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. He turned off the video.

Han Xiao appeared the most frequently in the entire show. It was as if all the good things were related to him. He gave the audience a feeling:

Black Phantom = opportunity!

Han Xiao did not expect that he would appear on screen so many times. His plan had paid off, and his reputation had increased again. The direct effect was that after the show was broadcasted, more players came to change their class, and he earned a lot of EXP.
